name: janpratinidhi
description: An open directory of India's elected representatives and their public records.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @janpratinidhi/api" "npm run dev -w @janpratinidhi/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @janpratinidhi/shared && npm run build -w @janpratinidhi/api && npm run build -w @janpratinidhi/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @janpratinidhi/shared && npm run typecheck -w @janpratinidhi/api && npm run typecheck -w @janpratinidhi/web
